# Python CLI Fixture

This is a test fixture for AI Context System v5.0.

## Stack

- Python 3.9+
- Click (CLI framework)
- Rich (terminal output)
- pytest (testing)

## Development

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

## Testing

```bash
pytest
```

## Usage

```bash
mycli hello
mycli hello --name World
mycli repeat -c 5
```
